title: Сожаление о завершённом событии
description: Сожаление о завершённом событии: разбираем конструкцию и её смысл на примерах, в диалоге и авторском тексте без аудирования.
objectives: Выражать сожаление о прошлом через wish + Past Perfect
Отличать фактическую ошибку от желаемого прошлого
notes: Wish + Past Perfect выражает сожаление о прошлом: I wish I had checked the date.
Wish + Past Simple обычно относится к нереальному настоящему; время выбирается по смыслу, а не по внешнему виду прошедшей формы.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: The deadline passed yesterday. I wish I ___ the form sooner.
exercises.explanation: Завершённое прошлое требует had submitted после wish.

exercises.prompt: Вставь подходящее слово из пары: read / reading.

public_payload.sentence: She wishes she had ___ the instructions more carefully.

exercises.editorial_answer: She wishes she had read the instructions more carefully.
exercises.explanation: После had требуется причастие read; его написание совпадает с инфинитивом.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Жаль, что я не проверил дату отправления.»
exercises.editorial_answer: I wish I had checked the departure date.
exercises.explanation: Had checked после wish описывает действие в прошлом, которого не было.

exercises.prompt: Исправь только ошибку в конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: He wishes he has saved the receipt last week.

accepted: He wishes he had saved the receipt last week.

exercises.reference_answer: He wishes he had saved the receipt last week.
exercises.incorrect_answer: He wishes he has saved the receipt last week.
exercises.editorial_answer: He wishes he had saved the receipt last week.
exercises.explanation: Last week указывает на прошлое сожаление: had saved.

public_payload.passage: Noah booked a workshop after reading a short announcement on his phone. He noticed the venue but overlooked the date. When he arrived a week late, the building was closed. He wished he had opened the full booking confirmation instead of relying on the announcement. The organiser offered him a place at a later workshop, but the original fee could not be refunded under the terms he had accepted. Noah decided to add future bookings to his calendar immediately.

options.label: He deliberately booked a closed building.
He arrived a week before the workshop.

exercises.explanation: Он не заметил дату и пришёл на неделю позже.

public_payload.passage: Noah booked a workshop after reading a short announcement on his phone. He noticed the venue but overlooked the date. When he arrived a week late, the building was closed. He wished he had opened the full booking confirmation instead of relying on the announcement. The organiser offered him a place at a later workshop, but the original fee could not be refunded under the terms he had accepted. Noah decided to add future bookings to his calendar immediately.

options.label: A free trip to the original venue.
A place at a later workshop.

exercises.editorial_answer: A place at a later workshop.
exercises.explanation: Предложение касалось другого занятия; возврат исходной суммы был исключён условиями.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: I missed the last bus because I did not check the timetable.

options.label: I wish I check it yesterday.
I wish I will checked it.
I wish I had checked it before leaving.

exercises.editorial_answer: I wish I had checked it before leaving.
exercises.explanation: Wish I had checked относится к конкретному несостоявшемуся действию в прошлом.

public_payload.sentence: If you fail to notice a small but important detail, you ___ it.

exercises.explanation: Overlook в этом контексте значит упустить из виду.
